commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+3' Milan Borjan (Canada) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
90+2' Alphonso Davies (Canada) takes the corner which is cleared.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' Canada are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
88' Sofyan Amrabat (Morocco) brings his opponent down. Raphael Claus has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
85' Walid Regragui has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Yahya Jabrane (Morocco) replacing Achraf Hakimi.
84' Steven Vitoria (Canada) has tested the patience of referee Raphael Claus and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
82' Alphonso Davies (Canada) is about to take a corner kick.
82' David Wotherspoon (Canada) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. Canada force their opponents to concede a corner.
82' The attendance for today's match is 43102.
80' Abderrazak Hamdallah (Morocco) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
78' Tajon Buchanan (Canada) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
78' Sofyan Amrabat (Morocco) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
76' It will be a substitution. Jawad El Yamiq (Morocco) is ready to enter the pitch as Azzedine Ounahi walks off.
76' Walid Regragui has decided to substitute Hakim Ziyech and he is replaced by Abderrazak Hamdallah (Morocco).
76' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and David Wotherspoon (Canada) will replace Junior Hoilett.
75' Junior Hoilett (Canada) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
74' Junior Hoilett (Canada) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
72' Alistair Johnston (Canada) blows a huge opportunity from inside the 6-yard box. He pounced on a rebound but headed it just over the crossbar.
72' CHANCE! Atiba Hutchinson (Canada) rises high to meet the resultant corner kick and attempts to steer his fine header past the goalkeeper, but only hits the crossbar!
71' There's an opportunity for Junior Hoilett (Canada) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
71' The free kick is taken by Alphonso Davies (Canada), but ball is cleared. The ball goes out of play and Canada have been awarded a corner kick.
70' Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
68' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Canada was in an offside position.
67' Flag up against Alphonso Davies (Canada). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
65' That will be all from Jonathan Osorio who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Richie Laryea (Canada).
65' Substitution. Selim Amallah (Morocco) replaces Abdelhamid Sabiri.
65' Here is a change. Sofiane Boufal is going off and Walid Regragui gives the last tactical orders to Zakaria Aboukhlal (Morocco).
64' The Canada players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
63' Junior Hoilett (Canada) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
60' The substitution has been made. Ismael Kone (Canada) has replaced Sam Adekugbe.
60' John Herdman prepares a substitution. Mark Kaye is replaced by Atiba Hutchinson (Canada).
60' The manager makes a subsitution with Jonathan David (Canada) coming on for Cyle Larin.
60' Junior Hoilett (Canada) picks up an injury.

58' Bono doesn't have to worry about this one. Junior Hoilett plays a pass into the feet of Alphonso Davies (Canada), who is unable to find the target as his effort from inside the box goes well wide of the right post.
56' Alphonso Davies (Canada) steps up to take the free kick, but his crossfield pass fails to reach any of his teammates.
56' Canada seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
55' Raphael Claus blows for a foul after Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
54' Raphael Claus couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Alistair Johnston (Canada) and blew his whistle.
51' Sofiane Boufal (Morocco) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
48' Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) sends a long ball in, but Milan Borjan comfortably gathers the ball.
46' Raphael Claus interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Tajon Buchanan (Canada).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+6' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' Youssef En Nesyri (Morocco) has a goal ruled out for offside!
45+3' It seemed like Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
45+2' Raphael Claus shows a yellow card to Sam Adekugbe (Canada) for his blatant foul.
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.
42' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Junior Hoilett (Canada). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
40' 1 - 2 What bad luck! Nayef Aguerd (Morocco) got in the way of a pass and unintentionally sent the ball past his own goalkeeper. The score is 1:2.
40' Sofiane Boufal (Morocco) is caught offside!
40' Sofiane Boufal (Morocco) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
39' Steven Vitoria (Canada) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Raphael Claus no option but to blow his whistle.
38' 2:6 – the total goal attempt statistics.
33' Abdelhamid Sabiri (Morocco) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
31' Youssef En Nesyri (Morocco) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
30' Sofiane Boufal (Morocco) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
26' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jonathan Osorio (Canada) was quite harsh and Raphael Claus didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
26' Jonathan Osorio (Canada) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
23' 0 - 2 Youssef En Nesyri (Morocco) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and drills a shot into the bottom right corner in trademark fashion.
22' Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
18' The Morocco players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
17' Youssef En Nesyri (Morocco) commits a rough challenge and Raphael Claus blows his whistle for a foul.
16' Fine play by Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) opens up space on the edge of the box for the shot, but his effort lacks accuracy and flies miles over the bar.
15' Cyle Larin sprays a pass out to Tajon Buchanan (Canada), but he produces a poor effort from inside the box which goes well wide of the left post.
14' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Abdelhamid Sabiri (Morocco) takes it short.
13' Noussair Mazraoui (Morocco) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
11' Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
10' Dangerous play by Cyle Larin (Canada). Raphael Claus blows his whistle for a foul.
9' Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.
9' Abdelhamid Sabiri (Morocco) decides to have a shot at goal from the free kick, but it hits the defensive wall. Morocco get a corner.
8' Abdelhamid Sabiri (Morocco) will take a free kick. Is he going to strike the ball directly at the goal? Let's find out!
7' Junior Hoilett (Canada) takes out his opponent with a horrific tackle and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
5' Raphael Claus has a clear sight and sees a foul from Cyle Larin (Canada).

4' 0 - 1 GOAL! And it’s the keeper’s mistake after his poor pass is easily intercepted by Hakim Ziyech (Morocco), who gleefully finds the net from mid range with a first time effort. That makes it 0:1.
3' This shall not pass! Mark Kaye (Canada) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
1' Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Morocco will take the kick-off.
